source.paper: papers/Krzakala 等 - 2026 - MSAlign Aligning Molecule and Mass Spectra representations for Metabolite Identification.pdf

common.dataset: MassSpecGym v1.5 official train/val; no val/test exchange
common.identity: RDKit canonical-isomeric SMILES; connectivity recomputed InChIKey first block
common.candidate_policy: reuse frozen index in full order; no insertion, formula filter, regeneration or new deduplication
common.negatives: uniform non-GT row sampling without replacement after existing held-out-connectivity exclusion; pad with masked zeros when short; GT retained
common.negative_identity_disclosure: pre-existing validation/test identity-only denylist is transductive; no new test file reads

selection.cadence: after each complete all-row epoch and final partial epoch at max steps

common.aggregation: single seed rows and arithmetic mean +/- sample SD of seed metrics; no best-seed selection; cross-method mean-logit ensemble deferred until separately frozen
common.ties: physical candidate-order permutation seed 20261014 with GT slot tracking; exact uniform expectation over GT tie group; retain greater/equal counts
common.missing_gt: retain query with contribution 0; report candidate recall; no inference GT insertion

controls.train_mean: only full official-train inputs; metadata recipient fixed
controls.wrong_spectrum: three frozen one-to-one same-adduct/exact-parent-mass/different-connectivity donor assignments; recipient candidates and metadata fixed; physical candidate permutation
controls.null: exact 1/N random; inherit train-only candidate adversary context, not sufficient for new full-system claim
controls.e1_scope: spectrum replacement tests leave CE/adduct fixed, so they isolate spectral readout conditional on metadata; CE/cohort causal claim excluded
controls.donor_assignments_asset: wrong_spectrum_assignments: load recipient_rows and seed{20260820,20260821,20260822}_donor_rows only; do not use old control metrics

common.runtime: float32; one GPU; start 0 CPU workers, maximum 2 after bounded memory soak; prefetch2 if workers; no external logging; GPU launch checks required; audit/development RDKit overlay /tmp/stage1_rdkit2025 currently supplies2025.09.6; archive/install pinned dependency before portable release
common.test: not accepted by development runner; final once-only S7 after whole-system freeze

spectrum.preprocessing: DataFormatA SpectrumPreprocessor; n_highest_peaks100; synthetic precursor as released DreaMS
spectrum.cache_action: build new train/val contrastive caches with data-safe checkpoint; existing no_head cache is not interchangeable

molecule.truncation_policy: record original token lengths/truncation count; keep rows; no val-dependent length choice
molecule.license: CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 with model-card extra terms; upstream model/cache redistribution not included

metadata.ce: released fixed sinusoid e/100/10000**(2i/d); learned missing vector; no trainable CE MLP
metadata.adduct: 16 category +16 polarity; sorted normalized train-only vocabulary; unknown index len(vocab); unknown polarity index2

training.objective: masked candidate CE with learned positive log-temperature; no in-batch or explicit hard mining

spectrum.peak_selection: np.argsort(intensity)[::-1], keep first100, original observed peaks only; zero-pad (100,2), float32
spectrum.bins: floor(mz/0.1); keep mz<=1005; clip index to[0,10049]; sum intensity
spectrum.mgf_input: existing official split-specific MGF by identifier; no re-rounded mz beyond stored .6f precision; retain precursor peak if actually observed; original TSV absent, record export rounding deviation

molecule.invalid: use existing audited canonical valid rows; new invalid aborts cache, never silently all-zero

training.schedule: same released linear warmup plus cosine
training.objective: masked candidate CE with trainable log_epsilon; normalized outputs

deviations: one official-val direction rather than published two val/test-swapped variants
v1.5 canonical-isomeric frozen index replaces release non-isomeric normalization and old-unversioned candidate filename
existing held-out identity exclusion for train negatives; report transductive identity exposure
train-only metadata vocabulary instead of all-metadata released vocabulary
development datamodules never construct test dataset or automatically evaluate test
common uniform-tie evaluator instead of released conservative >= rank rule
three fixed local training seeds instead of source seed42 / published split-direction averaging
data-safe DreaMS checkpoint replaces ordinary checkpoint; retain embedding head, unlike SCCF no_head
locked RDKit2025.09.6, bounded workers; environment differences logged
EmbCos existing MGF export m/z .6f rounding and empty-bin guard disclosed; do not claim exact raw TSV reproduction
required_before_gpu: adapted train/val-only runners and cache builders; source/config digest checks; use pinned Transformers4.53.3/tokenizers0.21.4 runtime overlay or equivalent isolated env
MolDeBERTa legitimate weight access/model-card terms verification; never print token
new E1 contrastive data-safe spectra cache and canonical-isomeric MolDeBERTa cache with digests
E2 split-specific peak/bin and Morgan bit caches with identity/order digests
new runtime input/cache/checkpoint digests and fresh host/cgroup/GPU memory checks
claim: matched adaptations, not exact paper reproduction; spectrum-sensitive/candidate-prior-affected; no clean/no-shortcut or synthesis-provenance claim
precursor_audit: optional train-only derivative metadata audit may be recorded; original TSV/source precision not available locally, so raw/source stratification and origin attribution remain pending
